"She Blinded Me with Science" is a song by the English musician Thomas Dolby, released in 1982.
It was first released as a single in the United Kingdom on 25 October 1982.
It was subsequently included on the EP Blinded by Science and the 1983 re-release of Dolby's debut album The Golden Age of Wireless.
